# 常用组件封装

# 基于 Element-UI 封装表格组件

<!--
 * @Author: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Date: 2023-07-26 08:50:38
 * @LastEditTime: 2023-08-11 16:29:24
 * @LastEditors: ZWJ
 * @Description: 封装Table组件（使用自定义列插槽时请严格按照自定义的插槽名）
 * @FilePath: \sass_operation_platform\src\components\Table\index.vue
-->
<template>
  <div>
    <!-- 操作行按钮 -->
    <el-row :gutter="10" class="mb8">
      <slot v-if="showLeftBtn" name="leftBtn"></slot>
    </el-row>
    <!-- 表格 -->
    <el-table
      ref="table"
      v-loading.fullscreen.lock="tableLoading"
      element-loading-background="rgb(0 0 0 / 20%)"
      :element-loading-text="t(`message.loadingData`)"
      :data="tableData"
      style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 30px"
      row-key="id"
      :row-class-name="tableRowClassName"
    >
      <!-- 空数据状态的插槽 -->
      <template #empty>
        <el-empty
          :image-size="100"
          :description="
            tableLoading ? t(`message.loadingData`) : t(`message.emptyData`)
          "
        ></el-empty>
      </template>
      <!-- 表格内容 -->
      <template v-for="item in columns" :key="item.key">
        <el-table-column
          v-if="item.visible"
          :prop="item.prop"
          :label="item.label"
          :width="item.width"
          :type="item.type"
          :fixed="item.fixed"
          :class-name="item.className"
          :show-overflow-tooltip="item.showTooltip || false"
        >
          <template v-if="item.useSlot" #default="scope">
            <slot :name="item.slotName" :row="scope.row"></slot>
          </template>
        </el-table-column>
      </template>
    </el-table>
    <!-- 分页 -->
    <div class="pagination">
      <el-pagination
        background
        v-model:current-page="page.page_num"
        v-model:page-size="page.page_size"
        :page-sizes="[10, 20, 50, 100]"
        layout="total, sizes, prev, pager, next, jumper"
        :total="parseInt(count)"
        @size-change="handleSizeChange"
        @current-change="handleCurrentChange"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
<script setup>
// 引入国际化
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
// 解构国际化
const { t } = useI18n()
const props = defineProps({
  // 显示Table顶部左侧
  showLeftBtn: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: true,
  },
  // 显示Table顶部右侧
  showRightBtn: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: true,
  },
  // 列数据配置
  columns: {
    type: Array,
    required: true,
  },
  // 表格加载状态
  tableLoading: {
    type: Boolean,
    required: true,
  },
  // 表格数据
  tableData: {
    type: Array,
    required: true,
  },
  // 表格行自定义列名
  tableRowClassName: {
    type: Function,
    default: ({ row, rowIndex }) => {
      if (rowIndex % 2 != 0) {
        return 'table-one-color'
      }
    },
  },
  // 是否显示分页器
  showPagination: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: true,
  },
  // 分页配置
  page: {
    type: Object,
  },
  // 分页器页码改变回调
  handleSizeChange: {
    type: Function,
  },
  // 分页器切页回调
  handleCurrentChange: {
    type: Function,
  },
  // 分页总数
  count: {
    type: Number,
  },
})
</script>
<style lang="scss">
.pagination {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  max-width: 753px;
  margin: 20px auto 0 auto;
}
</style>

使用：

// 使用
 <Table
        :columns="columns"
        :tableLoading="tableLoading"
        :tableData="tableData"
        v-model:page="page"
        :handleSizeChange="handleSizeChange"
        :handleCurrentChange="handleCurrentChange"
        :count="count"
        :showRightBtn="false"
      >
        <template #operateCol="scope">
          <el-button link type="primary" @click="openDialog(scope.row)">{{
            t('message.watch')
          }}</el-button>
        </template>
        <template #status="scope">
          <el-tag
            v-for="item in statusList"
            :key="item.label"
            :type="item.type"
            effect="light"
            v-show="item.label == scope.row.approval_status"
            >{{ item.label }}</el-tag
          >
        </template>
      </Table>
      
// 列数据
const columns = ref([
  {
    key: 0,
    label: t('message.serial'),
    visible: true,
    type: 'index',
    width: 100,
  },
  {
    key: 1,
    label: t('staffAttendanceStatistics.name'),
    prop: 'name',
    visible: true,
  },
  {
    key: 7,
    label: t('staffAttendanceRest.status'),
    useSlot: true,
    slotName: 'status',
    prop: 'approval_status',
    visible: true,
  },
  {
    key: 8,
    label: t('message.handle'),
    width: 150,
    className: 'table-btn-group',
    useSlot: true,
    slotName: 'operateCol',
    visible: true,
  },
])

# 基于 Element-UI 封装搜索组件

<!--
 * @Author: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Date: 2023-07-26 11:35:07
 * @LastEditTime: 2024-02-22 15:44:03
 * @LastEditors: ZWJ
 * @Description: 封装查询组件
    传入的options配置数据结构如下（其中，input，select，time数组至少要是一个空数组，每一个数组中的对象中的prop值应该也searchForm中的属性保持一致）：
    input: [
        {
            key: 1,
            label: t('operationLog.user_id'),
            prop: 'userId',
            placeholder: t('operationLog.user_id_p')
        },
    ],
    select: [
        {
            key: 2,
            label: t('operationLog.result'),
            prop: 'result',
            placeholder: t('operationLog.result_p'),
            selectOptions: [
                { value: 0, label: t('operationLog.success') },
                { value: 1, label: t('operationLog.fail') },
            ]
        }
    ],
    time: [
        {
            key: 3,
            label: t('operationLog.create_time'),
            timeRange: '',
            change: e => {
                options.searchForm.beforeTime = e[0];
                options.searchForm.afterTime = e[1];
            }
        }
    ],
    searchForm: {
        userId: '',
        ip: '',
        result: '',
        beforeTime: '',
        afterTime: '',
    }
 * @FilePath: \sass_operation_platform\src\components\Search\index.vue
-->
<template>
  <div>
    <el-form
      :model="searchForm"
      ref="queryForm"
      :inline="true"
      class="my-top-container"
    >
      <!-- 输入框 -->
      <template v-for="item in inputs" :key="item.key">
        <el-form-item :label="item.label" :prop="item.prop">
          <el-input
            style="width: 240px"
            v-model="searchForm[item.prop]"
            :placeholder="item.placeholder"
            clearable
          />
        </el-form-item>
      </template>
      <!-- 下拉框 -->
      <template v-for="item in selects" :key="item.key">
        <el-form-item :label="item.label" :prop="item.prop">
          <el-select
            style="width: 240px"
            v-model="searchForm[item.prop]"
            :placeholder="item.placeholder"
            clearable
            :multiple="item.multiple"
            collapse-tags
          >
            <el-option
              v-for="item in item.selectOptions"
              :key="item.value"
              :label="item.label"
              :value="item.value"
            />
          </el-select>
        </el-form-item>
      </template>
      <!-- 时间选择 -->
      <template v-for="item in times" :key="item.key">
        <el-form-item :label="item.label">
          <el-date-picker
            v-model="item.timeRange"
            type="datetimerange"
            @change="item.change"
            value-format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"
            :start-placeholder="$t('message.StartDate')"
            :end-placeholder="$t('message.EndDate')"
          />
        </el-form-item>
      </template>
      <!-- 自定义查询组件 -->
      <slot name="otherSeacher"></slot>
      <!-- 搜索与重置按钮组 -->
      <btnGroup @getList="getList" @reset="reset" v-if="showBtn" />
      <!-- 自定义按钮 -->
      <slot name="otherBtns"></slot>
    </el-form>
  </div>
</template>
<script setup>
const props = defineProps({
  // 输入框
  inputs: {
    type: Array,
    default: [],
  },
  // 下拉框
  selects: {
    type: Array,
    default: [],
  },
  // 时间选择
  times: {
    type: Array,
    default: [],
  },
  // 搜索表单绑定数据
  searchForm: {
    type: Object,
    required: true,
  },
  // 是否显示搜索与重置按钮组
  showBtn: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: true,
  },
  // 查询回调
  getList: {
    type: Function,
  },
  // 重置回调
  reset: {
    type: Function,
  },
})
</script>

使用：

<Search
      :inputs="options.inputs"
      :selects="options.selects"
      :times="options.times"
      v-model:searchForm="options.searchForm"
      :getList="search"
      :reset="reset"
      ><template #otherSeacher>
        <el-form-item
          :label="$t(`staffAttendanceDetail.department`)"
          prop="status"
        >
          <el-cascader
           :placeholder="
              $t(`message.select`) + $t(`staffAttendanceDetail.department`)
            "
            style="width: 240px"
            v-model="options.searchForm.dept_ids_list"
            :options="classOptions"
            :props="classProp"
            collapse-tags
            collapse-tags-tooltip
            max-collapse-tags="1"
          />
        </el-form-item> </template
    ></Search>
    
    // 定义搜索参数
const options = reactive({
  inputs: [
    {
      key: 1,
      label: t('staffAttendanceRest.restname'),
      prop: 'name',
      placeholder: t('message.enter') + t('staffAttendanceRest.restname'),
    },
  ],
  selects: [
    {
      key: 3,
      label: t('staffAttendanceRest.searchCheckStatus'),
      prop: 'approval_status',
      placeholder:
        t('message.select') + t('staffAttendanceRest.searchCheckStatus'),
      selectOptions: checkStatusList,
    },
  ],
  times: [
    {
      key: 1,
      label: t('staffAttendanceDetail.time'),
      timeRange: '',
      change: (e) => {
        if (!e) {
          options.searchForm.start_date = ''
          options.searchForm.end_date = ''
          return
        }
        options.searchForm.start_date = e[0]
        options.searchForm.end_date = e[1]
      },
    },
  ],
  searchForm: {
    start_date: '',
    end_date: '',
    name: '',
    dept_ids: [],
    dept_ids_list: [],
    approval_status: 4,
    leave_person_type: 2,
  },
})

# 优化 vue-baidu-map 渲染多个 marker 卡顿的问题(vue2,vue3 同理)

# 使用海量点去标出坐标位置 组件 BmPointCollection
<baidu-map class="map" @init="addPoints" :center="{ lng: 105.000, lat: 38.000 }" :zoom="4">
      <bm-point-collection :points="points" shape="BMAP_POINT_SHAPE_STAR" color="red" size="BMAP_POINT_SIZE_SMALL" @click="clickHandler"></bm-point-collection>
</baidu-map>

<script setup>
const points = ref([]);

const clickHandler = (e) => {
  alert(`单击点的坐标为：${e.point.lng}，${e.point.lat}`);
};

const addPoints = () => {
  const pointAll = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
    const position = { lng: Math.random() * 40 + 85, lat: Math.random() * 30 + 21 };
    pointAll.push(position);
  }
  points.value = pointAll;
};
</script>

优点：只渲染一次，速度快，流畅度好 缺点：无法自定义样式

# 使用点聚合 BmlMarkerClusterer
<baidu-map class="map" center="中国" :scroll-wheel-zoom="true" :double-click-zoom="true">
      <bml-marker-clusterer :averageCenter="true" :styles="styles">
        <bm-marker v-for="marker of markers" :key="marker" :position="{lng: marker.lng, lat: marker.lat}" @dragend="updateMarker($event, marker)" :dragging="true"></bm-marker>
      </bml-marker-clusterer>
</baidu-map>

优点：样式可以自定义，缩放后会将范围内的点渲染 1 个点 缺点：聚合后不方便查看，数据过多时同样会有一定的卡顿

# 查询可视区域坐标，筛选出可视区域内的点再去渲染
<baidu-map @ready="onReady" >
        <bm-marker
          v-for="(item, index) in markerList"
          :key="index"
          :position="{ lng: item.lng, lat: item.lat }"
          :title="item.name"
    ></bm-marker>
</baidu-map>

data(){
        return{
      // 地图实例
      map: null,
      // 可视区域示例
      bounds: null,
        }
},
computed:{
    markerList() {
      if (!this.bounds || !this.datalist.length) return []
      //可视区域左下角
      let SouthWest = this.bounds.getSouthWest()  
      //可视区域右上角                                                                                                                                                                                       
      let NorthEast = this.bounds.getNorthEast();   
      let markerList = []
      // 获取区域内的点
      this.datalist.forEach(item => {
        if (item.lng >= SouthWest.lng &&
          item.lng <= NorthEast.lng &&
          item.lat >= SouthWest.lat &&
          item.lat <= NorthEast.lat) {
          markerList.push(item)
        }
      })
      return markerList
    }
},
methods: {
    onReady({ map }) {
      this.map = map
      //获取可视区域
      this.bounds = map.getBounds()
      // 监听地图的缩放和拖拽
      map.addEventListener('dragend',this.getBounds)
      map.addEventListener('zoomend',this.getBounds)
    },
    // 获取地图的可视区域
    getBounds() {
      if (!this.map) return
      this.bounds = this.map.getBounds()
    }
  },
  destroyed() {
    if (this.map) {
      this.map.removeEventListener("dragend", this.getBounds)
      this.map.removeEventListener("zoomend", this.getBounds)
    }
  }

# Bing 地图封装

<!--
 * @Author: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Date: 2023-10-17 15:28:30
 * @LastEditTime: 2023-10-26 10:15:14
 * @LastEditors: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Description: 构造函数参数文档 -- https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/bingmaps/v8-web-control/map-control-api/mapoptions-object
 * @FilePath: \sight-bot\src\components\bingMap\index.vue
-->
<template>
  <div class="bingMap" id="bingMap"></div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { loadScript } from '@/utils/loader.js';
import { onMounted, watchEffect } from 'vue';
import starIcon from '@/assets/images/star.png';
let map = null;
let addPinFlag = false;
const props = defineProps({
  key: {
    type: String,
    default: 'Auu7rqgc0M1d7oJDohnOXNwkRVCaGRhPruBrVTbGir3MGE8mc8f6v-v2v7BCzBn7',
  },
  center: {
    type: Object,
    default: () => ({ lng: -74.044502, lat: 40.689247 }),
  },
  positionList: {
    type: Array,
    default: () => [
      {
        deviceSn: 1,
        coordinate: { lng: 116.404, lat: 39.915 },
        text: '1',
      },
    ],
  },
});
if (!window.initBingMap) {
  window.initBingMap = initMap;
}
if (!window.loadBingMapJS) {
  loadScript(
    `https://www.bing.com/api/maps/mapcontrol?callback=initBingMap&key=${props.key}`,
  );
}
watchEffect(() => {
  if (props.positionList.length >= 0) {
    addPin();
  }
});
onMounted(() => {
  if (window.loadBingMapJS) {
    initMap();
  }
});
function initMap() {
  window.loadBingMapJS = true;
  if (
    window.Microsoft &&
    window.Microsoft.Maps.Map &&
    window.Microsoft.Maps.Location
  ) {
    try {
      map = new Microsoft.Maps.Map('#bingMap', {
        // credentials: 'Auu7rqgc0M1d7oJDohnOXNwkRVCaGRhPruBrVTbGir3MGE8mc8f6v-v2v7BCzBn7',
        // Location(latitude: number, longitude: number)
        center: new Microsoft.Maps.Location(props.center.lat, props.center.lng),
        mapTypeId: Microsoft.Maps.MapTypeId.aerial,
        zoom: 5,
        showZoomButtons: false, // 显示缩放按钮
        showMapTypeSelector: false, // 显示地图类型切换
        showTermsLink: false, // 显示左下角条款链接
        showScalebar: false, // 显示比例尺
        showLocateMeButton: false, // 显示定位按钮
      });
      if (addPinFlag) {
        addPin();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('打印 --> error', error);
    }
  }
}
function createPin(item, isDrag = false) {
  let pin = null;
  if (Microsoft.Maps) {
    pin = new Microsoft.Maps.Pushpin(
      new Microsoft.Maps.Location(item.coordinate.lat, item.coordinate.lng),
      {
        text: item.text, // 文字
        icon: starIcon, // 自定义图标
        anchor: new Microsoft.Maps.Point(19, 19.5), // 图标相对于定位的地点 这个偏移值需要取自定义图片的宽高各一半
        textOffset: new Microsoft.Maps.Point(0, 12), // 文本相对于图片的偏移位置
        draggable: isDrag, // 是否可以使用鼠标或触摸将图钉拖动到新位置
      },
    );
  }
  return pin;
}
function addPin() {
  if (window.loadBingMapJS && map) {
    map.entities.clear();
    let pinArr = props.positionList.map((item) => {
      return createPin(item);
    });
    map.entities.push(pinArr);
    addPinFlag = false;
  } else {
    addPinFlag = true;
  }
}
</script>
<style lang="less" scoped>
.bingMap {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;

  /deep/#missingCredential {
    display: none;
  }

  /deep/.bm_bottomLeftOverlay {
    display: none;
  }
}
</style>

# 天地图封装

<!--
 * @Author: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Date: 2024-01-09 15:20:29
 * @LastEditTime: 2024-03-04 15:15:06
 * @LastEditors: NULL 1628069508@qq.com
 * @Description: 
 * @FilePath: \saas_school_platform\src\views\dataSignage\center\index.vue
-->
<template>
  <div
    class="map-wrap"
    id="mapDiv"
    v-loading="loading"
    element-loading-svg-view-box="-10, -10, 50, 50"
    element-loading-background="rgba(122, 122, 122, 0.2)"
  ></div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { onMounted, reactive, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import BuleIcon from '@/assets/images/dataSignage/bule.png'
import RedIcon from '@/assets/images/dataSignage/red.png'
import { getLocation } from '@/api/dataSignage/index.js'
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
import _ from 'lodash'
let timer = null
const timerNum = inject('timerNum')
const { t } = useI18n();
const center = reactive({
  Lng: 116.40969,
  Lat: 39.89945,
})
const loading = ref(true)
const $emits = defineEmits(['openMonitorDialog'])
const key = 'cc975593c483293955cb0efde7647e78'
const positionList = ref([])
let map = null
function loadScript(url) {
  const $script = document.createElement('script')
  $script.type = 'text/javascript'
  $script.src = url
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    $script.addEventListener('load', () => {
      resolve(true)
    })
    $script.addEventListener('error', () => {
      reject(false)
    })
    window.document.head.appendChild($script)
  })
}
onMounted(() => {
  loadScript(`http://api.tianditu.gov.cn/api?v=4.0&tk=${key}`).then(() => {
    getData()
  })
})
function initMap() {
  let zoom = 7
  map = new T.Map('mapDiv')
  map.centerAndZoom(new T.LngLat(center.Lng, center.Lat), zoom)
  map.clearOverLays()
  const pointArr = []
  positionList.value.forEach((item) => {
    const locationObj = getLngAndLat(item.coordinate)
    if (locationObj.Lng && locationObj.Lat) {
      const icon = new T.Icon({
        iconUrl: item.device_status === 1 ? BuleIcon : RedIcon,
        iconSize: new T.Point(63, 100),
        iconAnchor: new T.Point(31, 50),
      })
      const point = new T.LngLat(locationObj.Lng, locationObj.Lat)
      const marker = new T.Marker(point, { icon: icon })
      pointArr.push(point)
      map.addOverLay(marker)
      marker.addEventListener(
        'click',
        (e) => {
          clickHandler(item)
        },
        { passive: false }
      )
    }
  })
  map.setViewport(pointArr)
}
function clickHandler(data) {
  if (data.device_status === 1) {
    $emits('openMonitorDialog', data)
  } else {
    ElMessage.warning(t('dataSignage.offlineTip'))
  }
}
function getData() {
  loading.value = true
  getLocation({
    id: sessionStorage.getItem('tenantId') || '',
  })
    .then((res) => {
      if (res.data && res.data.length >= 0) {
        if (!_.isEqual(positionList.value, res.data)) {
          positionList.value = res.data
        }
        if (!map) {
          initMap()
        }
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          getData()
        }, timerNum)
      }
      loading.value = false
    })
    .catch((e) => {
      loading.value = false
      ElMessage.error(t('dataSignage.locationTip'))
    })
}
function getLngAndLat(str) {
  const locationArr = str.split(',')
  return {
    Lng: isNaN(Number(locationArr[0])) ? false : locationArr[0],
    Lat: isNaN(Number(locationArr[1])) ? false : locationArr[1],
  }
}
watch(
  positionList,
  () => {
    if (map) {
      map.clearOverLays()
      const pointArr = []
      positionList.value.forEach((item) => {
        const locationObj = getLngAndLat(item.coordinate)
        if (locationObj.Lng && locationObj.Lat) {
          const icon = new T.Icon({
            iconUrl: item.device_status === 1 ? BuleIcon : RedIcon,
            iconSize: new T.Point(63, 100),
            iconAnchor: new T.Point(31, 50),
          })
          const point = new T.LngLat(locationObj.Lng, locationObj.Lat)
          const marker = new T.Marker(point, { icon: icon })
          pointArr.push(point)
          map.addOverLay(marker)
          marker.addEventListener(
            'click',
            (e) => {
              clickHandler(item)
            },
            { passive: false }
          )
        }
      })
      map.setViewport(pointArr)
    }
  },
  {
    immediate: false,
  }
)
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (timer) {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
})
</script>
<style scoped lang="scss">
.map-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  height: calc(100% - 26px);
  position: relative;
  top: 26px;

  :deep(.tdt-control-copyright) {
    display: none !important;
  }
}
</style>
